fields.label: Dosage forms
fields.help: Sets the minimum grade (European Medicines Agency). We supply Purified Water, not Water for Injection.

fields.label: Client and market mix
fields.help: As a contract development and manufacturing organization: markets, regulators, stricter client limits; no client names.

fields.label: Release limits on the device
fields.help: For example endotoxin per device (USP <161>) or bioburden (ISO 11737-1).

fields.label: Do any lines make drugs or natural health products?
fields.help: Over-the-counter drugs count. Drug lines need Purified Water; cosmetic-only lines follow your specification.

Turnaround per request, for the requests table: URS review, compliance matrix, document review (one figure for loop, controls, fabrication, C&Q plan and FAT list reviews), scope review, feed water review, budget proposal, assessment, audit request (FD-01). Once filled, name each figure in its cell (gap review, matrix, proposal, document review), since the placeholder names then disappear

Cost per request, free or CAD, and whether a fee is credited against an order: URS review, compliance matrix, proposals, document review, scope review, feed water review ([cost of the feed water review], the canonical name in ops/placeholder-names.md), budget range, assessment, supplier audit, fit check (FD-02). The requests table shows all six rows (DR-024 rule 5). At launch a cost FD-02 has not set drops its row (DR-024 rule 6, DR-005 rule 8); "Free" only where FD-02 says so

Confirm reviews carry no obligation, and whether they may be used in the client's own tender ([review obligation and use in your tender], home's name; FD-02). Once confirmed, the lead may end "Nothing commits you to buy."
Whether a budget range comes in the first reply, and what the modules-and-budget answer contains for the PW package (pretreatment, RO, DI or EDI, distribution) (FD-02, FD-03)

Sales phone number and office hours with time zone (same names as contact-locations and CONTACT.sales; FD-33). The closing button dials once the number is filled in its label and its tel: link, in one commit. Unfilled at launch, it becomes "Talk to an engineer" to #intake (DR-006 rule 6)
Who reads and answers requests and sales calls; time zone and holiday cover (FD-34)

NDA turnaround, working days; confidentiality terms for submitted specifications (FD-01, FD-47). Their home is cmp-quality's terms block (DR-005 rule 7); once confirmed, the form note may open with one line on them ("Specifications stay confidential" was cut as unconfirmed)

Privacy notice (PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25, CASL): what is collected, who receives it, why, how long; file storage location and retention, months; maximum upload size, MB, or a secure upload link; counsel's check before launch (FD-39, OQ-81)

Form back end before launch: submission; on-screen and email acknowledgement naming the next step, who replies and by when; file storage; routing by intent (situation|follow-up) and source page (DR-014 rules 10 and 11; orchestrator)
Language for the reply (English, French) returns to step 3 only once a named French-speaking engineer replies within the same time (FD-36, DR-012 rule 2)

Visits (shop tour, test bay, factory acceptance test witness) are offered on contact-locations, by appointment with [shop visit notice, working days] notice (R6, DR-028 rule 3); this page keeps three routes. Reference requests have one answer, buying#faq (DR-028 rule 4); no reference route or field here
Makes and equipment types assessed on systems from other builders ([makes and equipment types serviced]; same name on home, services, svc-service, svc-upgrades, about, contact-service; FD-30)

Contact routes: service phone number and hours, severity 1 phone answer time ([severity 1 phone answer time, minutes], route 2's clock, as on contact-service and contact-locations; FD-27); audit request response time (same as cmp-quality; FD-48).
